local_checks.invariant: Filter inventory must fail closed on timeout, overrun, non-success, or a full 1 MiB read, and must not parse a partial listing.
local_checks.result: Holds. configured_filter_overrides_within uses one deadline, a 1 MiB take, and wait_until kill/reap. Partial listings are not parsed. The #207 include.path fifo path still fail-closes.

local_checks.invariant: Untrusted filter driver names must not inject an extra -c assignment or leave a same-repo clean, smudge, or process command active.
local_checks.result: Holds for the top-level repository. An equals sign in a driver refuses the inventory. Other bytes stay inside one -c argv. Empty overrides are explicit empty values.

local_checks.invariant: Top-level git_command must neutralize fsmonitor, hooks, ext-diff, and textconv on that process.
local_checks.result: Top-level argv holds: core.fsmonitor=false, hooksPath on the null device, redirect env removed, and diff calls pass --no-ext-diff and --no-textconv. Those flags are not forwarded to a submodule child.

local_checks.invariant: A submodule content diff spawned for the viewer's diff must not run the submodule diff.external or textconv program.
local_checks.result: Confirmed distinct from #207. On git 2.43.0 the viewer diff argv still executed a submodule diff.external marker when the superproject set diff.submodule=diff. The child argv was git diff --submodule=diff without --no-ext-diff. Omitting --attr-source also executed diff.<driver>.textconv. Adding -c diff.submodule=short stopped the marker.

assignment_notes: Revalidate merged PR #207. Do not re-open the include.path fifo hang if the 2s/1MiB fail-closed path still holds. A distinct command-execution bypass is in scope.
